# GeoTIFF.js

Vendored browser distribution of GeoTIFF.js 3.0.5, from the published npm package
`geotiff@3.0.5` (`dist-browser/geotiff.js`). Upstream:
https://github.com/geotiffjs/geotiff.js

MIT license: see `geotiff-LICENSE`. The bundle includes its upstream raster
decoders. It is loaded only by the DEM worker, without a CDN or runtime install.
The source map is not shipped.
